annotations.title: Replay a query from its replay token

description: Return the response a replay token was minted for, exactly as first returned, beside its immutable manifest, and re-verify it. The query is re-executed at the manifest's as-of date and the recomputation's hash compared with the recorded one: replay_mode is 'recomputed_verified' with matches_original_result true when they match, 'recomputed_format_changed' when the same filings and values come back in a response whose bytes differ, and 'recomputed_diverged' when the underlying data has changed since; in both of those matches_original_result is false and recomputed_result carries what the query returns now. When the query can no longer be re-executed, replay_mode is 'stored_manifest' and the original result is still returned. A replay token is shareable: anyone whose plan covers the query's company can replay it. The manifest returned is your organization's own when it executed the query, and otherwise the token's first manifest.

replay_token.description: Stable replay token returned by POST /v1/query/execute.
